message.content: Now let me look at the build script and the work-vul directory to understand how to build and test:

content:
Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/build.sh:
     1	
     2	mkdir -p $WORK/lwan
     3	cd $WORK/lwan
     4	cmake -GNinja   -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug        -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER="${CC}"      -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="${CFLAGS}"     $SRC/lwan/
     5	ninja -v liblwan.a
     6	zip -jr $OUT/request_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip $SRC/lwan/fuzz/corpus/corpus-request-*
     7	for fuzzer in $SRC/lwan/src/bin/fuzz/*_fuzzer.cc; do
     8	        executable=$(basename $fuzzer .cc)
     9	        $CXX $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11               -Wl,-whole-archive $WORK/lwan/src/lib/liblwan.a -Wl,-no-whole-archive           -I$SRC/lwan/src/lib $fuzzer             -lFuzzingEngine -lpthread -lz           -o $OUT/$executable
    10	done
    11
